summary: Enable the M152 production-code SDK write lane only for the two provider smoke files.

Run npm.cmd run codex:orchestrator:production-code-broader:smoke after recording the bounded proof.

rollbackPlan: Revert SDK_WRITE_PRODUCTION_CODE_PLANNED_PATH_ALLOWLIST to the M135/M146 single-file lane and remove or supersede the M152 audit packets if the proof does not pass cleanly.
